summary: Implemented the full range syntax from docs/ranges.md in pinset/ranges.py, fixed prerelease precedence in pinset/version.py, the outdated mark for unreadable ranges, and the why chain when a release label equals the root label. One existing test, tests/test_ranges.py CaretTest.test_zero_major, still fails because it and docs/changelog.md expect ^0.2.3 to stop before 0.3.0, while docs/ranges.md (PRV-7731) requires ^0.x to end before 1.0.0; I followed ranges.md and did not touch the tests.
